description: This file contains base classes, traits, and objects for serializing and deserializing MetricView objects to and from YAML format, including YAML configuration, parsing, and canonical form conversion logic.

classes.name: Constants
classes.description: Contains constant values used for YAML serialization, such as property keys and maximum property size.

classes.name: YamlMapperProviderBase
classes.description: Provides a configured Jackson ObjectMapper for YAML serialization/deserialization with specific formatting options.

classes.name: BaseMetricViewYAMLDeserializer
classes.description: Trait providing YAML parsing logic for MetricView objects, allowing subclasses to specify target class and YAML behavior.

classes.name: BaseMetricViewYAMLSerializer
classes.description: Trait providing YAML serialization logic for MetricView objects.

classes.name: ColumnBase
classes.description: Trait defining common properties and methods for columns, including conversion to canonical form.

classes.name: MetricViewBase
classes.description: Trait defining the structure of a MetricView, including version, source, filter, dimensions, measures, and conversion to canonical form.

classes.name: MetricViewBase
classes.description: Object with factory method to instantiate version-specific MetricView objects from canonical form.

methods.name: mapperWithAllFields
methods.description: Provides a configured ObjectMapper for YAML with specific formatting and inclusion rules.

methods.name: parseYaml
methods.description: Parses YAML content into an object of type T using the configured ObjectMapper.

methods.name: getTargetClass
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the class type for deserialization.

methods.name: toYaml
methods.description: Serializes an object of type T into a YAML string.

methods.name: toCanonical
methods.description: Converts a ColumnBase to its canonical form with proper ordinal and dimension/measure designation.

methods.name: toCanonical
methods.description: Converts a MetricViewBase to its canonical form, normalizing dimensions and measures with proper ordinals.

methods.name: fromCanonical
methods.description: Factory method to create a version-specific MetricView from its canonical form.
